versions.content: The J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_ J1939DcmGetNextDTCwithLampStatus, except the maximum sequence counter threshold per MainFunction is reached (see J1939DcmMaxDTCsPerMainFunction ) or the return ed value is ‘ DEM_PENDING ’. In this case, the execution is postponed to the next J1939Dcm_MainFunction call.
